content: {"praised":["Animation and lighting effects were impressive.","Greek gods and mythological elements were well portrayed.","Story had adventurous and exciting moments.","Characters like Percy and Poseidon were engaging.","Overall tone felt fun and energetic."],"criticized":["Story became dull after Zeus and Poseidon scenes.","Dumbed-down tone irritated younger viewers.","Plot felt too simplified for older audiences.","Certain scenes, like Empire State building, were unappealing.","Pacing was uneven, causing boredom in parts."]}
